service_registry_auth_type.description: The auth type to use for the services endpoint of the MCMA Service Registry

service_registry_url.description: The url to the services endpoint of the MCMA Service Registry

access_key.description: The AWS access key to use for authentication. Requires that secret_key also be specified

profile.description: The AWS profile to use for authentication

region.description: The AWS region to use for authentication

secret_key.description: The AWS secret key to use for authentication. Requires that access_key also be specified

api_key.description: The MCMA API key (header = 'x-mcma-api-key') to use for authentication

custom_properties.description: A collection of key-value pairs specifying additional properties for the job profile.

date_created.description: The date and time at which the job profile data was created.

date_modified.description: The date and time at which the job profile data was last modified.

id.description: The ID of the job profile. MCMA IDs are always absolute urls.

name.description: The name of the job profile.

type.description: The MCMA type of resource. This value will always be 'JobProfile'.

name.description: The name of the input parameter.

optional.description: Flag indicating if this input parameter must be provided or not

type.description: The type of the input parameter. Should specify an MCMA resource or primitive type.

block.description: A list of input parameters (name and type) that must be provided when running a job for this profile.

name.description: The name of the output parameter.

type.description: The type of the output parameter. Should specify an MCMA resource or primitive type.

block.description: A list of output parameters (name and type) that will be set on the job when the service has finished.

id.description: The ID of the service. MCMA IDs are always absolute urls.

resource_json.description: The JSON of the object to be created

block.description: An arbitrary MCMA resource managed through a service registered in the MCMA service registry

auth_type.description: The type of authentication the service uses, e.g. AWS4

date_created.description: The date and time at which the service data was created.

date_modified.description: The date and time at which the service data was last modified.

id.description: The ID of the service. MCMA IDs are always absolute urls.

job_profile_ids.description: The list of IDs for job profiles that can be processed by this service. If the service does not process jobs, this should be empty.

job_type.description: The type of job the service processes, if any. Most MCMA services will handle some kind of job, but not all of them have to.

type.description: The MCMA type of resource. This value will always be 'Service'.

auth_type.description: The type of authentication expected for this endpoint. This should only be specified if it is different than the auth type specified on the service.

date_created.description: The date and time at which the resource endpoint data was created.

date_modified.description: The date and time at which the resource endpoint data was last modified.

id.description: The ID of the resource endpoint. MCMA IDs are always absolute urls.

resource_type.description: The type of MCMA resource this endpoint handles.

type.description: The MCMA type of resource. This value will always be 'ResourceEndpoint'.
